To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the retailer's and manufacturer's advertising expenditures in cooperative game is higher than those in the Nash game and the manufacturer's participation in the retailer's advertising expenditure depends on the differences between the unit costs of new and used products.
the manufacturer's willingness to participate in retailer's green advertising is affected by the differences between the manufacturing and remanufactured products costs.

the manufacturer's participation in the retailer's advertising expenditure is more effective in increasing the retailer's green and manufacturer's national advertising expenditures than the retailer's green advertisement alone.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to encourage customers to participate in the closed loop supply chain by using green advertising and how to share the benefits of green advertising among channel members.
the effects of cooperative advertising in closed loop supply chains.
the impact of cooperative advertising in the closed loop supply chain and the effect of the manufacturer's incentives for collecting more used products.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cooperative advertising is an effective tool for a closed loop supply chains to encourage customers to bring their used products back.
in a closed loop system, the manufacturer should cooperate with the retailer to encourage customers to participate in the reverse supply chain.
the retailer and manufacturer can increase the return rate by cooperating with each other in a closed loop environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cooperative advertising can be a good tool for a closed loop supply chains to increase their profits.
the manufacturer should pay the retailer's green and national advertising expenditures to collect more used and new products and to increase the profit of the closed loop supply chain.
cooperative advertising can be a good way to increase the return of used products and consequently increase the profit of both the retailer and manufacturer in a closed loop system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the manufacturer should be encouraged to participate in the green advertising expenditure of the retailer.
, the manufacturer's willingness to participate in the cooperative advertising game depends on the differences between the cost of manufacturing new and the remanufacturing cost of used products.
the manufacturer and the retailer should cooperate in order to increase the return of used products and consequently increase their profits.
